query: INSERT INTO whatsapp_tc_tokens (account_id, jid, token, token_timestamp, sender_timestamp) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, NULL) ON CONFLICT (account_id, jid) DO UPDATE SET token = EXCLUDED.token, token_timestamp = EXCLUDED.token_timestamp WHERE whatsapp_tc_tokens.token IS NULL OR EXCLUDED.token_timestamp >= whatsapp_tc_tokens.token_timestamp
